newsitem.title: CHINA: China sees colour tube output over 23 mln in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China sees colour tube output over 23 mln in 1997.

text.p: China is to increase output of colour picture tubes and colour display tubes to 23 million in 1997 from 19.5 million last year, an official of the Ministry of Electronics Industry told Reuters on Monday.
Of the total output of 23 million, 21 million would be colour picture tubes and the rest colour display tubes, the official said.
China's output of colour televisions and colour displays was estimated at 23 million for 1997, of which seven million were for export, he said.
By the year 2000, China's output of colour picture and display tubes was estimated to reach 50 million, the official said without giving further details.
